description: Skin appearance [REG-03]: physically-inspired colour parameters [SKN-10], surface state [SKN-31], [SKN-32], micro-detail generator settings with their per-region modulation maps [SKN-20], [SKN-22], [DOC-05], and wrinkle depth by region. Values reach the shaders through material parameter blocks.

defaults.provisional: The skin model of [SKN-10] is not derived yet (docs/shader-notes.md): the value is normalised to 0..1 and the default is a placeholder until the model and the Fitzpatrick swatch validation calibrate it.

parameters.description: Total melanin in the epidermis: higher values give darker skin, lower values paler skin. The main skin-tone control.
Share of brown-black eumelanin in the melanin; lower values leave more red-yellow pheomelanin, giving a warmer, more olive or golden tone.
Blood in the dermis: higher values give a ruddier, pinker skin, lower values a paler, sallow one.
Oxygen saturation of the blood: high values give a bright red flush, low values a bluish, purple tint.
Carotenoid pigment: higher values add a yellow-orange tint, strongest where the skin is thick (palms, soles).
Thickness of the epidermis: thicker skin hides the blood colour and scatters light more evenly; thinner skin looks more translucent and veined.
Skin oil on the surface: higher values give a sharper, brighter sheen, most visible on the forehead and nose.
Hydration of the skin surface: low values look dry and matte with visible flaking texture, high values smooth and supple.
Sweat or water on the skin: adds a thin glossy film that lowers the specular roughness; 0 is dry.
Blushing or exertion: raises the redness of cheeks, nose, ears and neck on top of the base haemoglobin; 0 is the resting colour.
Amount of age and sun spots (small flat brown patches) on face, hands and other sun-exposed skin; 0 is none.
How many pores the micro-detail generator places per area; the per-region map scales it further (nose and cheeks denser, eyelids finer).
How deep the pores are; deeper pores cast stronger micro-shadows and read as rougher skin in close-ups.
The diameter of the pores; larger pores are visible from further away.
How much the pores stretch along the skin's directional lines; 0 gives round pores.
A texture blob that modulates the pore density per region (a painted or generated map); none uses the template's per-region defaults.
Depth of the fine crosshatched skin lines between the pores; deeper lines make the skin look older and more textured.
Spacing of the fine skin lines; larger values give a coarser pattern.
A texture blob that modulates the fine-line depth per region; none uses the template's per-region defaults.
Depth of the resting horizontal forehead lines; 0 is smooth.
Depth of the resting vertical lines between the eyebrows; 0 is smooth.
Depth of the resting lines fanning out from the outer corner of the eye; 0 is smooth.
Depth of the resting fold from the side of the nose to the mouth corner; 0 is a soft fold.
Depth of the horizontal rings across the front of the neck; 0 is smooth.
Density of the fine vellus hair on cheeks, upper lip, forehead and ears; shows as a soft bright rim in backlight.
How many freckles the generator places per square centimetre of the masked area. Read by the freckles generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
Typical diameter of one freckle in millimetres; individual freckles vary around it. Read by the freckles generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
How much pheomelanin-rich pigment each freckle adds; 0 makes them invisible. Read by the freckles generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
How strongly freckles gather in patches instead of spreading evenly over the area. Read by the freckles generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
How many moles (naevi) are placed in the masked area by Poisson-disk sampling. Read by the moles generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
Typical diameter of one mole in millimetres. Read by the moles generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
How dark the moles are relative to the surrounding skin; 0 matches the skin. Read by the moles generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
How far the moles rise above the skin surface in millimetres; 0 is flat. Read by the moles generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
How many scars are drawn in the masked area. Read by the scars generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
Typical length of one scar in millimetres. Read by the scars generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
Typical width of one scar in millimetres. Read by the scars generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
Height of the scar against the skin in millimetres: positive is raised (hypertrophic), negative is sunken (atrophic). Read by the scars generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
Blood colour of the scar: positive values give a fresh pink-red scar, negative values a pale, older one. Read by the scars generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
How many papules are placed in the masked area. Read by the acne generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
Typical diameter of one papule in millimetres. Read by the acne generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
How much blood colour each papule adds; 0 leaves only the relief. Read by the acne generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
Into how many clusters the papules are grouped. Read by the acne generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
How many parallel stretch marks are drawn in the masked area. Read by the stretch marks generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
Typical length of one stretch mark in millimetres. Read by the stretch marks generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
Typical width of one stretch mark in millimetres. Read by the stretch marks generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
Direction of the stretch marks in degrees, measured in the UV plane from the U axis. Read by the stretch marks generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
How new the marks are: fresh marks are red-purple, old ones pale and silvery. Read by the stretch marks generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
How many vein trunks are grown in the masked area before branching. Read by the veins generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
Typical length of one vein trunk in millimetres. Read by the veins generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
Typical width of a vein trunk in millimetres; branches get thinner. Read by the veins generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
How strongly the deoxygenated blood of the veins shows through the skin as a bluish tint. Read by the veins generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
How often a vein forks into smaller branches. Read by the veins generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
Horizontal centre of the tattoo decal inside the target rectangle, from its left edge (0) to its right edge (1). Read by the tattoo generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
Vertical centre of the tattoo decal inside the target rectangle, from its top edge (0) to its bottom edge (1). Read by the tattoo generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
Width of the tattoo decal on the skin in millimetres; the height follows the aspect ratio of the image. Read by the tattoo generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
Rotation of the tattoo decal in degrees in the UV plane. Read by the tattoo generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
How strongly the tattoo ink covers the skin colour; 0 hides it. Read by the tattoo generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
Depth of the generated macro wrinkle lines in millimetres. Read by the wrinkles generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
How many lines the wrinkle pattern (fan, rows or fold) draws. Read by the wrinkles generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
Width of one generated wrinkle line in millimetres. Read by the wrinkles generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
How set-in the wrinkles look: older lines are longer, more even and more continuous. Read by the wrinkles generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
How much darker the skin under the eyes is than its surroundings. Read by the under eye generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
How much of the darkening is the bluish tint of venous blood rather than brown pigment. Read by the under eye generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
How gradually the darkening fades into the cheek; 0 is a sharp edge. Read by the under eye generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
How many solar lentigines (sun or age spots) are placed in the masked area. Read by the sun spots generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
Typical diameter of one sun spot in millimetres; the patches have irregular edges. Read by the sun spots generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
How much brown pigment each sun spot adds; 0 makes them invisible. Read by the sun spots generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
How many vertical lip lines are drawn per millimetre across the lips. Read by the lip lines generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
Depth of the vertical lip lines in millimetres. Read by the lip lines generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
Width of one lip line in millimetres. Read by the lip lines generator [OTH-02]; its output is an ordinary skin layer.
